mapper.select: select uid, chat_no, region_id from `user` where chat_no = #{chatNo} limit 1 for update
select uid, chat_no, nickname, region_id from `user` where chat_no = #{chatNo} limit 1
select count(1) from fm_family_user where uid = #{uid}
select count(1) from fm_family where family_no = #{familyNo}
mapper.insert: insert into fm_family (family_no, uid, family_name, family_logo, status, create_time, update_time, user_num, room_num, family_room_num, whatsapp, create_source, region_id) values (#{familyNo}, #{captainUid}, #{request.familyName}, #{request.familyLogo}, 1, now(), now(), 1, 0, 0, #{request.whatsapp}, 0, #{regionId})
insert into fm_family_user (uid, family_id, type, anchor_status, role_id, create_time, first_join, region_id) values (#{captainUid}, #{familyId}, 0, 0, 0, now(), 1, #{regionId})
insert into bd_user_family (bd_user_id, family_id, family_new_user_num, create_time, region_id) values (#{bdUserId}, #{familyId}, 0, now(), #{regionId})
mapper.sql: from fm_family f left join `user` captain on captain.uid = f.uid left join bd_user_family responsible_relation on responsible_relation.family_id = f.family_id left join bd_user responsible_bd on responsible_bd.bd_user_id = responsible_relation.bd_user_id left join ( select family_id, count(1) as anchor_count from fm_family_user where anchor_status = 1 group by family_id ) anchor_stat on anchor_stat.family_id = f.family_id left join ( select buf.family_id, coalesce(sum(case when day_stat.count_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} then day_stat.gold_num + day_stat.luck_gold_num else 0 end), 0) as range_flow, coalesce(sum(case when day_stat.count_day between #{weekStartDate} and #{endDate} then day_stat.gold_num + day_stat.luck_gold_num else 0 end), 0) as week_flow, coalesce(sum(case when day_stat.count_day between #{monthStartDate} and #{endDate} then day_stat.gold_num + day_stat.luck_gold_num else 0 end), 0) as month_flow, coalesce(sum(day_stat.gold_num + day_stat.luck_gold_num), 0) as total_flow from bd_user_family_day day_stat join bd_user_family buf on buf.id = day_stat.bd_user_family_id where day_stat.count_day <= #{endDate} group by buf.family_id ) flow on flow.family_id = f.family_id
mapper.select:
select f.family_id, f.family_no, f.family_name, captain.chat_no as captain_chat_no, captain.nickname as captain_nickname, responsible_bd.uid as responsible_woha_uid, ifnull(anchor_stat.anchor_count, 0) as anchor_count, ifnull(flow.range_flow, 0) as range_flow, ifnull(flow.week_flow, 0) as week_flow, ifnull(flow.month_flow, 0) as month_flow, ifnull(flow.total_flow, 0) as total_flow, case f.create_source when 0 then '外管创建' when 1 then '入驻申请' else '未知' end as create_method, case f.status when 1 then '正常' when 2 then '隐藏' when 3 then '会长解散' when 4 then '管理员解散' else '异常' end as status_name, f.create_time
order by f.create_time desc, f.family_id desc

select coalesce(sum(ifnull(flow.range_flow, 0)), 0) as range_flow, coalesce(sum(ifnull(flow.week_flow, 0)), 0) as week_flow, coalesce(sum(ifnull(flow.month_flow, 0)), 0) as month_flow, coalesce(sum(ifnull(flow.total_flow, 0)), 0) as total_flow
